Partial sums over the 18 rows present are recorded separately under partial_totals_by_region for cross-checking only. Unblocking requires a re-issued complete records.csv covering R001-R024; once supplied, this job runs to completion with no other changes. An independent verification pass of the CSV reproduced the same row count, the same missing IDs, and the same partial sums reported by the earlier job in this batch.
